name: Alcatel Submarine Networks’ SDM1 cable design
summary: A submarine cable design that increases parallel fibre pairs and shares optical repeater pump resources.
description: Alcatel Submarine Networks developed SDM1 as a cost-oriented submarine cable architecture combining a higher fibre count with lower per-fibre signal power and shared repeater pumping. It reports full qualification in 2019.

date.basis: Conference year reported by the designer.

events.statement: Alcatel Submarine Networks presented a 16-fibre-pair cable at SubOptic.
events.caveats: The source establishes a presentation. It gives no live service or sale for this event.

evidence.supports: The supplier dates the 16-pair presentation and traces its SDM1 design to this period.

date.basis: Year of full qualification stated by the supplier.

events.statement: Alcatel Submarine Networks reports completing qualification of SDM1.
events.caveats: Qualification protocol and exact date were not given in the retained evidence.

evidence.supports: Supplier distinguishes the 2016 presentation from the 2019 qualification.
